protocol.source: archived continuous-neural-state teacher 830 Q scores; first 12 of 24 training rows
protocol.generic: non-teacher bits from fixed cue-occurrence veto positions, delivered through same measured DN spike path
protocol.streams: key=studentSeed*10000000+round; neural key+2, proposal key+501, alternative key+701; shuffle rng(2026110601+studentSeed); veto-position rng(2026110701+10*studentSeed+cue)

validity.generic: exact 1/3/3 own-VPN-cue veto quota, correct/generic rejection difference <=1 per cue at 6 and 12, <=2 total at 12
validity.actionDistribution: correct/generic played-action counts differ <=3 per action across 11 observed training rounds
validity.shuffle: >=2/11 bits moved, counts preserved, <=60% balanced quality
validity.source: archived teacher 830 64/72 frozen, 24 saved real-neural Q rows, prior reset-receiver gate passed
validity.route: 11/11 observed training, 69/69 frozen, cue-free first round
validity.receiver: all actual DN bits decode with intended target dominance
validity.learning: selected-head own-reward Q equation, no other head/synapse updates, frozen weights unchanged
validity.checkpoint: independent simulator objects; exact live neural, controller, game, reward and RNG-reference state unchanged

protocol.primary: at round 6 each correct arm exceeds generic/shuffled/untrained >=4/72, disconnected >=8/72, and has >=1 extra correctly rewarded cue1/paper or cue2/scissors update; both students plus all validity gates
